definition: Required public payload/release is missing or insufficient.
Required fields/semantics are absent, incompatible or ambiguous.
Branches use different release generations or analysis frames without an exact transport mapping.
Event membership differs and the difference cannot be isolated from the tested factor.
Artifact/PE/data lineage cannot be proven identical.
Public object exists but is represented in a form incompatible with the preregistered metric without an additional transformation.
Relevant artifact/model exists but was intentionally excluded by a prior frozen scope.
Multiple analysis dimensions change together; a unique cause cannot be isolated.
